name: EntityAmendSpec
lead: Called when a new entity of this kind spawns; told, never waited on.

functions.name: on_spawn
functions.description: Called when a new entity of this kind spawns; told, never waited on.

functions.name: on_load
functions.description: Called for an entity that already existed: a saved chunk loaded it, or a reload rebound it.

functions.name: on_steer
functions.description: Wrapped behavior runs first unless options.replace = true.

functions.name: on_tick
functions.description: Wrapped behavior runs first unless options.replace = true.

functions.name: on_damage
functions.description: Asked when it takes damage; return "ignore" to cancel it. Silence or a missed deadline is "take".

functions.name: on_remove
functions.description: Called when it leaves the world; `why` is "removed", "settled", "killed" or "unloaded". Not called when the pack goes away.
